title: 200 foreigners intercepted in alleged Zamboanga Sibugay scam hub
summary: Government operatives rounded up some 200 foreigners and seized around 2,000 cellphones in an anti-scam operation in Alicia and Siay towns in Zamboanga Sibugay.
